_doc: The BREACHPOINT design token system, read live from Figma variables + text styles.
_authority: This file SUPERSEDES the hand-copied hex tables in docs/UI-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §2 and docs/ui/REFERENCE-EXTRACTION.md §2. Those were transcribed; these were read from the variables themselves. Where they disagree, this wins and the doc is corrected.
_law: ui-presentation §9: the palette is defined ONCE and every widget reads it. Never type hex into a WBP — a WBP is binary and unreviewable, so twelve widgets with typed hex is twelve places a rebrand breaks silently and the critic can diff none of them.
_semantic_rule: The Semantic layer is entirely ALIASES onto Primitives. That indirection is the point: `surface/panel` -> `black/50` means a re-theme edits one primitive, not forty call sites. Consume the SEMANTIC name in code; never reach past it to the primitive.

semantic._discipline: A token means ONE thing. hud/threat is a threat channel — do not spend it on a non-lethal low-ammo warning or a UI error. hud/health is yellow and NEVER green: green reads as 'fine' at exactly the moment the player is one shot from dead. hud/health is hidden until damaged.
semantic._hud_vs_frontend: The rarity ramp is DECORATIVE and is forbidden on the HUD (REFERENCE-EXTRACTION §7 conflict 2). Front end is flat and near-monochrome; the HUD carries full VISR semantics. If the HUD shield bar and the lobby progress bar look identical, one of them is wrong.

type._families: Rajdhani (chrome, all-caps labels) + Roboto Condensed (body, and the ONLY italic). Rajdhani ships no italic, which is why Body/Flavor is Roboto — that split is deliberate and is the same substitution the reference file itself makes. Both are OFL.
type._letter_spacing: Figma records PERCENT. UMG's Letter Spacing is 1/1000 em, so multiply by 10: 15% -> 150, 10% -> 100, 8% -> 80, 20% -> 200. The extreme spacing is the signature of the language — at 14px, 15% is roughly 1.07em. Reproduce it; it is most of why the chrome reads as military UI.

layout._note: Mode is 'Base 1280'. Author every WBP in this space; the DPI curve does the 1920 conversion (UIScaleRule=ShortestSide, 720->1.0, 1080->1.5). No number here is ever multiplied by hand.

_findings.stroke_focus_3: layout.stroke has FOUR weights (0.5/1/2/3), not the three COMPONENT-SPECS §0 records. The fourth is `stroke/focus = 3` — the nav-tab active border, drawn OUTSIDE. The Styles lane previously flagged 3px as a conflict and substituted 2; this variable settles it: 3 is authored and intended. Correct the components.
_findings.grey_panel: `grey/panel = #36383f` is a NON-BLACK menu ground and appears in no doc. It is aliased as surface/menu-ground.
_findings.visr_dead: `visr/dead = #4a5a6b` — a dead/eliminated state colour absent from UI-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md §2.
_findings.accent_steel_sky: accent/steel and accent/sky are defined as primitives but nothing in Semantic aliases them — unused, or a gap. Do not consume a primitive directly to 'use them up'; find out what they were for.
_findings.offsystem_fonts_bp73: BP73 (3 Aug 2026) measured four text nodes in the REFERENCE file and three resolve to no row in type.styles: Roboto Condensed Bold 14 ls 0 (Button Prompts verb, node 119:1491); Rajdhani Bold 18 ls 100 UPPER and Rajdhani SemiBold 18 ls 0 (Roster Group Header label and count, node 927:43301). The ladder here jumps Heading/Panel 16 → Display/Title 20, and carries Roboto Condensed only at Medium 14 / SemiBold 12. NO ROWS ADDED — three node reads are not a style extraction, and BP73's scope forbids it. Either this extraction missed styles or those nodes are off-system in the source; a style sweep decides. The fourth, the feature-card caption (node 1769:23147), resolves exactly to Label/Button.
